newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Heavy rains close Philippine stock market, govt.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rains close Philippine stock market, govt.

text.p: The Philippine stock market was closed on Tuesday, along with all government officies and there will be no bank clearing due to heavy rains hitting the capital, officials said.

"All government offices were declared closed and so is the central bank. I have heard that the Bankers Association of the Philippines have announced that there's no clearing today," central bank governor Gabriel Singson told a local radio station.
Philippine Stock Exchange human resources and administration head Digna de los Reyes said that trading on the stock market is suspended for the day.
A Bankers Association of the Philippines official confirmed that there would be no trading on the Philippine dealing system, the official currency market.
The presidential palace announced that government offices were closed due to the bad weather which had brought traffic in Manila almost to a halt on Monday evening.
